items.name: Blackbranch Knifeshade
items.art_brief: Preserve the lean Blackbranch Cutthroat: low reed hood, crescent paired knives, layered reed cloak and pale peatwax knife marks. The upgrade reads as a concealed marsh ambusher, never a new species.
items.gameplay_rationale: A low-tier setup consumer: backstab now recognizes Mireclaw snares and roots as well as ordinary harry/stagger. It can exploit the allied branch and ferry-chain control without acquiring an independent disable; clean-target damage is unchanged.

abilities.name: Knife Beneath the Reeds
abilities.description: Cuts deeper into harried, staggered, mire-snared or root-marked prey, and into stacks at or below 55% health.

items.name: Knotroot Trappers
items.art_brief: Preserve the Reedsnare Kin: compact marsh folk carrying braided root loops, hooked snare staffs and woven reed shoulder mats; a clearly visible root coil replaces simple cord.
items.gameplay_rationale: A cooperative low-tier controller: two supported snares per battle can affect tier-2 or higher melee stacks, but still require another ally adjacent to the target. Each snare also reduces initiative, rewarding an encircling pair rather than a lone cheap lock.

abilities.name: Knotroot Closing Circle
abilities.description: Twice per battle, snares a tier-2 or higher melee survivor if another ally stands beside that target; its cohesion and initiative fall for one round.

items.name: Ironfen Bulwark
items.art_brief: Preserve the hulking Bog Brute: overlapping bog-iron shell plates, thick marsh hide, broad driftwood shield bound with oxidized iron, low steady stance.
items.gameplay_rationale: An army screen: existing ranged durability now also reduces contact melee damage suffered by allied ranged and shielding stacks by 8%. It provides a reason to keep this slow brute alive while the mire ranged branch prepares targets; the screen does not stack additively.

abilities.name: Ironfen Living Screen
abilities.description: Bog-iron hide blunts ranged fire. While the bulwark survives, allied ranged and shield-bearing stacks take 8% less contact melee damage.

items.name: Shattermire Slingers
items.art_brief: Preserve the Mudglass Slingers: long sling, amber-green mudglass shot, twin sealed jars at the belt, shard-studded reed mask and practical marsh wraps.
items.gameplay_rationale: A flexible ranged disrupter: two blinding shots now cover tier-3 and higher stacks of either attack type, dropping attack and initiative for one round. Broader targeting supports counter-fire or a melee interception; no permanent blind or extra damage is invented.

abilities.name: Shattermire Eyeline
abilities.description: Twice per battle, a hit on a tier-3 or higher survivor scatters mudglass across its eye-line, reducing attack and initiative and marking it for the pack for one round.

items.name: Gorefen Redhook
items.art_brief: Preserve the fast lean Gorefen Ripper: long crimson hooked talons, swept reed mane, shallow bronze hook fittings and forward hunting stance; distinguish it from the much heavier tier-6 packlord.
items.gameplay_rationale: A mobile executioner: retains the wounded-prey/backstab package, adding one round-2 hook attack across a partially closed lane at 35% damage. The survivor is pulled into contact and root-marked, so access rather than raw damage is the upgrade payoff.

abilities.name: Canal Hook Finish
abilities.description: Cuts deeper into prey already slowed or weakened by the pack and snowballs the kill beat.

abilities.name: Bloodrush
abilities.description: Surges faster, strikes harder, and spikes battlefield momentum once prey is wounded or already under pack pressure.

abilities.name: Redhook Pursuit
abilities.description: Once from round two, the extended redhook crosses a partially closed lane at 35% damage, pulling the survivor into contact and leaving a root mark for one round.

items.name: Bogplate Gatebreakers
items.art_brief: Preserve the broad Bogplate Mauler: scarred overlapping shell, unusually long split-log maul with bog-iron teeth, massive forearms and grounded stance; a lever weapon rather than a sleek assassin.
items.gameplay_rationale: A lane breaker: a 60%-damage reach strike can attack and retaliate across a partially closed lane without pulling the victim. Shielding payoff now recognizes roots as well as Mireclaw marks, giving ferry-chain control a slower armored finisher.

abilities.name: Gatebreaker Bogplate
abilities.description: Layered bogplate blunts ranged fire and the maul bites harder against mire-snared or root-marked enemies.

abilities.name: Split-Log Leverage
abilities.description: The long maul strikes and retaliates across a partially closed lane at 60% damage.

items.name: Blackwater Chainmasters
items.art_brief: Preserve the Ferrychain Lasher: enormous hooked ferry chain coiled over one shoulder, blackened chain gauntlets, reed-and-hide ferryman mantle and two heavy anchor hooks.
items.gameplay_rationale: An opening displacement specialist: two hookline uses are available from round one at 35% lane damage. It can pull and root-mark two survivors over separate attacks, opening space and targets for its pack; unlike reach the special lane access is spent.

abilities.name: Blackwater Double Mooring
abilities.description: Twice per battle from round one, casts a ferry hook across a partially closed lane at 35% damage, pulling the survivor into contact and leaving a root mark for one round.

items.name: Mireglass Dissonants
items.art_brief: Preserve the Mireglass Reedcaster: forked reed staff cradling cyan-green resonating globes, thin glass bells, reed robes and a sharply readable asymmetrical instrument silhouette.
items.gameplay_rationale: A single-target melee opening: one ranged cast now affects tier-3 and higher survivors with a 20% retaliation penalty and a Mireclaw pack mark. It prepares one dangerous defender for an immediate melee follow-up; the effect lasts one round.

abilities.name: Mireglass Answerbreak
abilities.description: Once per battle, a ranged hit on a tier-3 or higher survivor leaves it mire-marked with -1 cohesion and 20% weaker retaliation for one round.

items.name: Rotchoir Cantors
items.art_brief: Preserve the Sporewake Chanter: broad fungal spore mantle, open reed chanting mask, hanging luminous seed censer and layered swamp-cloth vestments; muted ochre spores over dark green.
items.gameplay_rationale: A sustained attrition caster: two rot calls last two rounds, retaining the tier-4 gate, with -2 cohesion and 5% weaker retaliation. Wounded damage becomes 8% at half health; unlike Dissonants this pays for repeated formation pressure rather than one sharp retaliation break.

abilities.name: Rotchoir Lingering Cant
abilities.description: Twice per battle, ranged hits rot-call tier-4 or higher survivors for two rounds, reducing cohesion by 2 and retaliation by 5%. Shots deal 8% more damage to stacks at or below half health.

items.name: Fenbell Tollreapers
items.art_brief: Preserve the Fenbell Chainstalker: low hood, hooked bell-chain sickles, small bronze toll bells and taut chain crossing the body; predatory long stride and dark reed wrappings.
items.gameplay_rationale: A contact setup specialist: its once-per-battle tier-4 strike now leaves a root mark while reducing defense and cohesion, and its backstab recognizes root-marked targets. This primes a priority threat already reached in melee for allied root payoffs; it does not grant the Chainmaster lane pull.

abilities.name: Last Fenbell Toll
abilities.description: Once per battle, a strike on a tier-4 or higher survivor leaves a root mark for one round and reduces defense and cohesion by 1.

abilities.name: Tollreaper Cut
abilities.description: Primary melee attacks cut deeper into harried, mire-snared, staggered or root-marked targets, and into stacks at or below half health.

items.name: Gorefen Packlords
items.art_brief: Preserve the heavy tier-6 Gorefen Rippers: antlerbone shoulder mantle, huge hooked claws, marsh-hide trophies and dense muscular silhouette; visibly heavier and more commanding than the tier-3 Redhook.
items.gameplay_rationale: An isolated-prey commander: isolated attacks gain 12% rather than 2%, and one hit on a tier-5 or higher survivor leaves a defense-reducing Mireclaw mark for the pack. The clean-line damage penalty and quarter-health trigger remain, so the first elite hit can be weaker while setting up subsequent allies.

abilities.name: Packlord Cull
abilities.description: Primary melee attacks punish isolated prey by 12% and exploit wounded or disrupted targets; intact supported lines still reduce the initial attack to 75% damage.

abilities.name: Packlord Quarry Mark
abilities.description: Once per battle, a hit on a tier-5 or higher survivor marks it for the pack and reduces its defense by 1 for one round.

items.name: Crown of the Drowned Fen
items.art_brief: Preserve the Drowned Antler Sovereign creature: monumental drowned antlers threaded with living reeds and peatwax lamps, water-dark hide, hanging roots and ancient bronze crown fittings. Keep its quadruped or original body plan and massive sovereign silhouette.
items.gameplay_rationale: A defending apex controller: while defending, retaliation root-marks a surviving attacker for one round, setting up the existing root-marked-prey rout on the following attack. Choosing defend now establishes control, while unchanged clean-line penalties discourage indiscriminate charging.

abilities.name: Drowned Antler Rout
abilities.description: The sovereign yields ground before an intact line, then tramples wounded, harried, staggered, or root-marked prey and carries a kill into the next collapse.

abilities.name: Roots of the Drowned Crown
abilities.description: While defending, retaliations strike 5% harder and leave a root mark on surviving attackers for one round; holding ground grants 1 cohesion.
